physician.heading: Creating beauty is an art.
paragraphs: Dr Sherif El Wakil is the founder and medical director of Dr SW Clinics on London’s Harley Street, with more than two decades of experience across leading hospitals in the UK and Middle East, including The Royal London Hospital NHS Trust.

Holding degrees in both medicine and the arts, Dr Wakil applies a simple philosophy to his practice: that creating beauty is an art. His keen personal interest in art and sculpting allows him to deliver natural-looking results, so patients never look overdone — which is why they travel from around the world to see him. He offers only treatments that are safe, effective and minimally invasive, carefully tailored to each individual.

He is a pioneer of many techniques, often the first to introduce them to the United Kingdom — most significantly The O Concept™ for treating male and female sexual dysfunction. He was also the first UK practitioner to introduce the “soft surgery” approach, including non-surgical blepharoplasty, and PRP therapies such as the Vampire Facelift™ and Vampire Breast Lift™. With more than 25,000 cases worldwide — across clinics in London, Dubai and Egypt, headquartered at 77 Harley Street — he is an international trainer and speaker, and the President and Founder of the International Association of Aesthetic Gynaecology and Sexual Well-being (IAAGSW).

promise.heading: Natural results. *Always.*
paragraphs: Our mission is simple to state and demanding to keep: to provide real solutions for sexual dysfunction and to enhance sexual wellness — with kindness, discretion and privacy at every step.

Every patient is treated as a unique individual, with a bespoke solution built from their own diagnostics — never a menu, never a template. And one promise holds above all: you will never leave looking “overdone” or artificial. Natural results, always.
